lines.text: Jesus enters a village, and a woman named Martha welcomes Him into her home.
Martha's sister Mary sits at the feet of Jesus, listening to His message.
Martha, distracted by preparations, asks Jesus to tell her sister Mary to help her serve.
Jesus tells Martha, Martha, that she is worried and upset about three things.
Jesus says Mary has chosen the good portion, and He sends her to help Martha.

wrong_details.wrong: He sends her to help Martha
wrong_details.true: it will not be taken away from her
